items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Ada Ward, Ada Brisktop got us the job there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Up in New York before -- he was the first. Baron Wilkins had a basement club. And he was -- it was a popular club. But the guys didn't really start hanging out there in a bunch until we came because he had never heard nobody like us. So the word spread and they come down there. The place was so packed they couldn't accommodate all the musicians trying to come in, you know. And one set rule that we had at that time, we were paid for entertaining people so we couldn't let just anybody walk in and play. We…
Baron Wilkins we had -- Ada Ward, Ada Brisktop got us the job there.
